settings.voiceStyle: บทสนทนาสั้นแบบธรรมชาติ หนึ่งคนพูดต่อหนึ่ง scene สลับ C-SHARP และ ARI เพื่อป้องกันเสียงสลับหรือลิปซิงก์ผิด ไม่มีผู้บรรยาย
settings.customCharacterStyle: Two consistent stylized Roblox-style East Asian boy avatars inspired broadly by the uploaded reference image. Both have fair/light skin and dark-brown hair. C-SHARP is visibly taller/older; ARI is visibly shorter/younger. Preserve exact face design, skin tone, hair, outfits, props and proportions across every scene. No floating names or overhead UI.
settings.visualStyle: Bright family-friendly Roblox-style adventure world with colorful obstacle levels, clean readable shapes, cheerful lighting and smooth cinematic movement. No dark horror, no realistic injury, no official logos, no copied UI, no floating usernames, no name labels, no chat bubbles, no health bars, no subtitles or text above character heads.
settings.customProjectStructure: Vertical 9:16 Roblox-style adventure, 16 scenes x 8 seconds. One level per episode and a complete ending. One main action per scene. One speaker per scene, alternating between brothers. Keep dialogue short. For scene 2 onward, use the immediately previous generated scene image as the continuity reference in PRO V6.8 whenever the action/location continues, preserving exact character identity, screen direction, obstacle state and lighting for a smooth transition.
settings.customVisualStyle: Colorful stylized game cinematic with blocky avatars, playful physics, glossy toy materials, varied camera angles and smooth scene-to-scene continuity. Avoid repeated identical framing.

C-SHARP.instruction: Pronounce C-SHARP as ซีชาร์ป in spoken Thai dialogue.

ARI.instruction: Pronounce ARI as อาริ (Ah-ree), two syllables.

movie.mainStoryPrompt: Bright family-friendly Roblox-style adventure. C-SHARP and ARI are two stylized East Asian brothers inspired broadly by the uploaded reference photo: both fair/light-skinned with dark-brown hair; C-SHARP is taller and older, ARI shorter and younger. Never show floating names, usernames, labels, chat bubbles, health bars or text above their heads. EP01 is one complete Beginner Obby adventure: a glowing controller opens a portal, the brothers enter, learn the obstacle rules, cross platforms, disappearing bridge, button gate and rotating obstacle, reach the final checkpoint, cross the finish and return to the Lobby. Use one speaker per scene and alternate speakers to reduce voice/lip-sync errors. Keep the silent brother's mouth closed with natural reactions. For scene 2 onward, use the immediately previous scene image as continuity reference whenever possible so poses, faces, outfits, positions, lighting and level state connect smoothly.
movie.storySummary: C-SHARP และ ARI สองพี่น้องเด็กเอเชียผิวขาวแบบ stylized game avatars เจอ Portal จากจอยเกมเรืองแสงและหลุดเข้าสู่ Beginner Obby ทั้งคู่ช่วยกันอ่านจังหวะ แก้ปุ่ม ผ่านสะพานหายและสิ่งกีดขวางจนถึงเส้นชัย ก่อนกลับ Lobby ได้สำเร็จในตอนเดียว

scenes.imageDescription: Use scene 15 as character and pose continuity reference while transitioning through the portal. Return to the bright Lobby with the same exact fair/light-skinned East Asian child avatars, faces, hair, outfits, props and height relationship. Portal fades behind them. No floating names, usernames, labels, chat bubbles, health bars, achievement text, captions, subtitles or logos.
scenes.videoPrompt: Smooth portal transition from scene 15 into the Lobby. Medium-wide ending shot with both brothers taking two steps forward and looking at each other. Only ARI speaks after they fully exit the portal; C-SHARP stays silent and smiles. Audio: portal fade, ARI line, soft completion chime, music resolves. No narration or visible text.

characterSheets.seriesContinuity: Use the same C-SHARP and ARI designs across all episodes. Both are stylized East Asian boys with fair/light skin and dark-brown hair. C-SHARP is always taller/older; ARI always shorter/younger. Never display character names or usernames above their heads. For connected scenes use the previous generated scene image as reference in PRO V6.8 when available.

continuityRules.names: System names remain C-SHARP and ARI. Spoken Thai names are ซีชาร์ป and อาริ.
continuityRules.noNameplates: Never show floating names, usernames, labels, chat bubbles, health bars, score UI, subtitles, captions or text above either character's head.
continuityRules.visualIdentity: Both brothers are stylized East Asian boys with fair/light skin and dark-brown hair. C-SHARP is taller/older; ARI shorter/younger. Keep faces, skin tone, outfits, hair, props and proportions identical across scenes.
continuityRules.dialogue: Exactly one speaking character per scene in EP01, alternating C-SHARP then ARI. The non-speaker stays silent and should not lip-sync. Dialogue must be short enough to finish comfortably inside 8 seconds.
continuityRules.previousSceneReference: For scene 2 onward, use the immediately previous generated scene image as the primary scene reference in PRO V6.8 whenever location/time/action continues. Start from the prior ending pose/position and preserve screen direction, obstacle state, lighting and character identity. Use character sheets as the identity fallback when a location jump occurs.
continuityRules.camera: Vary camera angles across scenes and avoid repeating the same push-in/side-track pattern. Use wide reveal, low side follow, over-shoulder, frontal medium, three-quarter and gentle arc while maintaining spatial continuity.
continuityRules.format: 9:16, 16 scenes, 8 seconds each, one main action per scene, one Beginner Obby level, complete ending, bright and not dark.
